note: v3 retest card. The GRAPH, POPULATION, CAPTURE and all conventions are UNCHANGED from the W-v2 card (referenced above, sha-pinned): same redesigned write path (content keys + tied reads + content-conditioned values) at initialization, both arms, same probe face, same parity gate, same v2-aware capture with bitwise cross-checks. This card pins only the ANALYSIS delta required by prereg v3: the closed-form readout is computed in BOTH protocols (face-isolated = binding, M_final = diagnostic) from the same captured keys and written values.

analysis.face_isolated_binding: per (group, head) stack: M_face = values.T @ keys (sum of the 22 rank-one face writes), V_hat = M_face K (G + 1e-6 I)^{-1}, G = K^T K; NN decode of V_hat columns to the captured written values; binding closed_form_accuracy = MAX over the 8 stacks of the DECISION-BIT accuracy of the decoded event's gold answer (same scorer and aggregation conventions as rounds 1-2); event-id accuracy reported alongside
analysis.m_final_diagnostic: identical computation with M_final (end-of-replay F) instead of M_face; reported per stack, never binding; continuity with the v1/v2 readings
analysis.controls: v2 capacity-capped definitions, unchanged; computed on the forced F matrix as in rounds 1-2
analysis.verdict: v3 decision rule and precedence via the committed fec1.checkpoint_verdict with the binding closed_form fed as extras['closed_form_accuracy']; the value_space_collapsed extension clause (face-isolated < 0.3 with key gates and alignment passing) is evaluated explicitly in the runner
